Lovely result: P-256's seed was lrand48 seeded with a 1997 timestamp. Hard to see a backdoor in that. 

Funny twist: it was only recoverable because 1990s PRNGs are weak enough to recognize. The weakness is what made it auditable.https://t.co/blNOwl0pKy
